{{Top|leg}}
'''Green Dystopia''' was one of the barrooms of [[Quarek'k]], a large bar complex located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] shortly after the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="ss">''[[Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows]]''</ref>

In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]] visited the bar during her hunt for the former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jax Pavan]]. Sing was told to seek out [[Calathi]], who was in the Green Dystopia, by the [[Crimson Redrum]] [[Unidentified bartender (Crimson Redrum)|bartender]] when Sing asked for information regarding Pavan.<ref name="ss" />
